title: Consultation with agency.
bodyText: Before giving any opinion or recommendation that is critical of an agency or person, the ombudsman shall consult with that agency or person.
bodyHtml: §96-11  Consultation with agency.  Before giving any opinion or recommendation that is critical of an agency or person, the ombudsman shall consult with that agency or person. [L 1967, c 306, §12; HRS §96-11]
